notes.title: Keyboard Remapping Now Available!
notes.content:
After a few requests I've decided to tackle was I thought was going to be pretty hard ... and it was!

Controller remapping (for the keyboard) is now available for the Windows build of We Are Not Alone.

[h3]Why not Linux and Mac?[/h3]
This will require further testing, and will be updated as soon as I'm comfortable it works correctly.

[h3]What about controllers?[/h3]
Controller remapping is quite a bit more difficult, given how many different types of controller are out there! 

Steam already has a way to remap controller controls built in, so I'd highly recommend using that while you wait for me to create another update.

More information can be found here: [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/features/steam_controller/getting_started_for_players]Steam Controller Information[/url]

[h3]How come I can't remap the interact or mouse controls?[/h3]
This was unfortunately part of the way I designed the input originally and will require a lengthy rewrite. It's on the cards, but not right this minute - sorry!

[h3]Uhhh something broke and I can't play the game[/h3]
Quit the game and restart. For the initial run of remapping, I have set it to not save key rebindings when you quit and restart the game, just in case the worst happens. Thankfully, rebinding keys is a super quick thing to do!

Thanks again to everyone who has played, don't forget to leave a review :)

notes.title: The Frame Rate Update!
notes.content:
Alright, this is a big one! It includes many minor fixes, but the notes below will focus only on the two biggest ones. The update size is a little bigger this time, due to engine version changes. Any further should be smaller.

[h3]The FPS Boost[/h3]
There has been a major change to the character controller when it comes to error handling. In certain situations the frame rate will be boosted by up to 50%, and it will also reduce certain lag spikes.
[i]Since initial release there was an error that I'd originally just supressed and ignored ... who knew logging an error 200 times PER SECOND would have issues? Note to all devs: lazy fixes come back to bite you![/i]

[h3]Charlie's Floating Laptop[/h3]
This one is probably more important than the FPS boost. Some players have reported that Charlie's laptop was floating on this desk sometimes. This has been fixed.
[i]I know this was terrifying, I'm sorry. You can now sleep well.[/i]

Thanks again to all who have reported issues - I really appreciate it!

notes.title: 1.7.2 Update

A big thank you to those who have let me know about bugs so that I can get them fixed as soon as possible! 

A shorter list today, BUT ... there's a few that have been here for awhile that I'm happy to say are fixed!

[list]
[*]Fixed and issue where you could avoid the monster and basically soft lock. SHE is now angrier, and Riley won't let you trigger this event unless she is carrying the right tool. [i]Riley will let you know if you have it or not.[/i]
[*]Fixed a variable being incorrectly set to false, meaning you could both die AND complete your objective. [i]This obviously broke things :)[/i]
[*]Mouse sensitivity when loading a saved game is no longer ridiculously high!
[*]Improve code for setting of volume and graphics settings on scene load. This no longer runs once every few seconds and instead only at the start of the scene when things have changed!
[*]Reduced time it takes for doorbell to ring in the first scene. Now 20 seconds instead of 30. Helps the pace a little.
[*]Riley no longer telepathically interacts with items in the store room if she is outside the door.
[*]Fixed blue flicker when picking up the camera in the main living area.
[*]Fixed the blue screen flash when collecting camera in reception/labs area.
[/list]

Known Issues:
[list]
[*]Stuttering in main living area seems fixed. Further testing is happening to make sure.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.6 Update
notes.content:
The v1.6 update is now live with the following fixes and additions:

[h3]Normalised Voice Lines[/h3]
Certain voice lines have been filtered and normalised. There should no longer be a major disparity between characters.

[h3]More Puzzle Hints[/h3]
If you try something incorrect, but not [b]entirely [/b]incorrect, you should get better hints than in previous versions.

[h3]Inventory "Examine"[/h3]
Right click / left trigger on inventory items to get a little description. There might be some little easter eggs in there!

[h3]Item Interactions[/h3]
Are you sick of nothing happening when you use an inventory item on something? Well, now with v1.6, something will happen! There are some extra little things here now too ... maybe don't use the knife in act 2 on characters.

[h3]Light Baking[/h3]
Fixed an issue where looking outside of Riley's dorm would show a very ugly light bake in the distance. This has been fixed in the Windows version and (hopefully) Linux + Mac.

[h3]Teleportation[/h3]
There are a few instances in the game where Riley can get ... stuck. Now, if this happens, in 8 seconds she will teleport to her destination. [b]Why 8 and not 10? Because 8 is cooler and my favourite number.[/b]

[h3]Autosave Us All[/h3]
In previous versions when entering the save game menu you could override the autosave. This ability has now been removed. [b]Why did I think it was a good idea to allow that before? We'll never know.[/b]

[h3]Main Camera Is Now Encased In a Black Box[/h3]
Uhhh, yep you read that right. This is just to try fix issues where you could see outside the world in certain loading saved game events.

[h3]Do these version numbers mean anything? [/h3]
Not really, I started incrementing really quickly with each patch so it's already at 1.6

[/list]

[b]Once again a big thank you to everyone, for your patience, and for your support. I'm a solo dev and have tried and will keep trying my hardest to bring the quality YOU deserve.
[/b]
-Andrew

notes.title: New Demo Available!
notes.content:
[h1]A new demo?![/h1]

Yes, that's right! A new demo for We Are Not Alone has been released.

The game has come a long way from the original demo so I felt it right to do an update now.

The new update includes:

[list]
[*] New character models
[*] Updated locations
[*] More story
[*] More tension
[*] An entirely redesigned menu system and user interface
[*] More that I don't want to spoil!
[/list]

[h1]What about the Mac and Linux versions?[/h1]

[strike]So things got a bit out of hand organising this update to the demo, but rest assured the Mac and Linux demos will be available in 24-48 hours.[/strike]

These have now been updated too!

[h1]Don't you have an Indiegogo campaign?[/h1]
I sure do! The main goal is to be able to fund voice actors, a sound designer and composer for this project. 

If you'd like to check it out; here's a link: https://igg.me/at/wearenotalone/

[h1]I Found a Bug/Issue/Glitch[/h1]
No problems! Please let me know via the forums and I'll patch it as quick as possible.

----------
Big thank you to all who have played, who are new, and those sharing the game around - I couldn't do it without you and really appreciate the support.

-Andrew

notes.title: Linux Demo Now Available
notes.content:
A quick update, but something that has been [b]heavily [/b]requested, is the demo for Linux!

The Linux demo has been tested on the latest version of Ubuntu. 

When playing please note there are some known technical issues:
[list]
[*] vSync is non-functional. This appears to be a Unity bug and a workaround will be worked on for the final game release.
[*] Launching through Steam forces the use of the Vulkan renderer, due to a bug with Nvidia cards and OpenGL. If you notice strange shadow glitches, it has most likely defaulted back to OpenGL.
[/list]

Thanks for playing, and the continued support! 

Don't forget to check out the Kickstarter: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wearenotalone/we-are-not-alone-1/]Click here for Kickstarter![/url]
